result:
I wrote the spoken reply to `reply.txt` in the run folder.

The folder held `FACTS.md`, `prompt.txt`, `session.json` and `session.err`. The last two were empty, so `FACTS.md` was the only source of rules or facts. It had no explicit spoken-reply rules. The `DESIGN.md` spoken-reply rules mentioned in the git log aren't in this folder, so I didn't apply them. I wrote for the ear instead: short sentences, numbers spelled out, and no URLs or symbols.

The reply says a standard DESIGN.md is a page of written rules, while her system adds one token file that builds the styles, the Figma library and the rules Claude reads. It then gives the round 2 results. The standard file passed 118 of 120 pages and produced 30 button styles and 16 field styles. Her system passed 120 of 120 with 7 button styles and 4 field styles. It ends by pointing to the case study.
